name: Legal-Embed-bge-base-en-v1.5
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5 (config.json max_position_embeddings 512). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (BERT), full attention, no causal mask
notes: ADDED 2026-10-26. A finetune of BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.109 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2025-05-24. CAVEATS: Evaluated on the authors' own legal QA dataset with 162 test samples - small enough that the 768d gain (0.0307) is within noise. Matryoshka loss, so the 64d row is the interesting one. Task=embedding; nDCG@10 with cosine similarity.

benchmarks.config: Card Evaluation table, Dimension 768 row: Baseline 0.6105 vs Fine-tuned 0.6412 (+5.03%). 1,456 train / 162 test samples, Matryoshka loss.
